notes_for_editor: Only two lists name Oshell, both with the same place (Little Shakwa Lake, Stralak). Neither gives a build date, design, height, owner or staffing. The brief's LIO point (46.801909, -81.972105) is not cited, because the geohub page did not yield readable text in the cache. The Upper Shakwa Lake record (46.82206, -81.97081) is about 2.2 km from that point by our own check, and the sources do not confirm a same-tower match. Algoma District is not stated for Oshell itself, so it is left out. Verify with the Ontario LIO fire-tower layer or MNR records before any status change.
